title: tenant-standby-slo-adapter-and-staged-circuit-recovery
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: during multi-tenant overloads we observe oscillation between full circuit trips and rapid reopen attempts for low-priority tenants which increases tail latency for everyone. This PR introduces a "tenant standby" SLO adapter and a staged circuit recovery mechanism to (1) proactively place low-priority tenants into a standby mode when cluster SLO headroom drops below configured thresholds, (2) apply a soft, exponentially-windowed backoff to circuit reopen attempts to avoid immediate flapping, and (3) expose operator-tunable controls for staging, warmup, and recovery windows. Design summary: - New SLO adapter component runs in the request-router and subscribes to the global SLO stream (derived from latency/availability aggregates) - When headroom < soft_threshold, non-critical tenants are demoted to standby: requests are routed to a lower-cost slowpath (batching + relaxed re-ranking) and token budgets are throttled down - Standby routing preserves correctness by still honoring request-level hints (priority overrides, emergency flags) - Staged circuit recovery uses a 3-phase policy: probed-reopen (single-probe), capped-reopen (limited concurrency), and fully-open (gradual concurrency ramp) with configurable backoff and jitter - Added metrics and events: standby_transitions, staged_reopen_attempts, staged_reopen_failures, reopen_cooldown_seconds - Operator console: new Liveview panel showing tenant states and recent staged reopen events This description includes implementation notes, tests, and rollout plan.

release_notes: Introduce tenant standby mode and staged circuit recovery to reduce p99 tail impacts from low-priority tenants during cluster overloads. Configurable thresholds and operator controls provided. Rollout behind feature flag.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative: defaults will not change tenant behavior until explicitly enabled. Observability instrumentation was a priority to ensure safe ramping.
changelog_entry: Added tenant standby SLO adapter and staged circuit reopen policy. Ops: see docs/ops/standby-slo-adapter.md for rollout steps.
